Plugin.Name: Disk Rescue
Plugin.Overview:
Rescue data from a failing Unraid disk. Copies files to a healthy disk while monitoring the average speed over a sliding window (default 10s / 10MB/s) and skipping stalled files, keeping already-read data as *.partial. Includes a read-only pre-scan, resume support, failure list and live progress in the WebGUI.
从坏盘抢救数据：按「最近 N 秒平均速度」判定卡死并跳过，已读数据保留为 *.partial， 支持预扫描、断点续跑、失败清单和实时进度。
